**Finding: missing (insurance covenant absent) — redline proposed and validated.**

- **What we found:** No programme-level insurance article exists anywhere in the Outsourcing Base Agreement or its Attachments. The only insurance references are asset-specific (§13.1 replacement-value cover on consigned Products with IBM as joint insured; §21.2 IBM insures its own tooling with MSL jointly insured) or cost allocations (NIC/shipment freight insurance).
- **Why it matters:** MSL holds IBM inventory and tooling, operates from leased IBM premises, and accesses IBM applications, networks and customer data (§24.1), so the rule applies. With no CGL, E&O, workers' compensation or cyber coverage required, the document fails even the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M).
- **Fix:** New Section 16.22 (Insurance) inserted at the end of the General article at preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where IBM/customer data is processed, workers' comp as required by law, certificates on request), expressly stated to be additive to the existing consigned-Product and tooling insurance obligations. The comment flags the fallback limits as an available compromise.
